text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, and I’d be glad to help create the female AI avatar you described.

I work in Python and machine learning, with 6 years of experience building practical AI systems. For your project, I can help produce a realistic-looking female avatar with the visual style you want: brunette hair, blue eyes, blush on the cheeks, cute gaming headphones, and a setup in front of a green or blue screen while seated in a gaming chair. I can also help shape the avatar so her mouth movements match speaking, and prepare separate clips that show the different emotional expressions you listed: sad, happy, mad, annoyed, laughing hard, giggling, and frustrated.

I understand you want the result to feel realistic and usable for voiceover later, so I’d focus on clean mouth motion, expressive facial movement, and consistent presentation across all clips. If you already have reference images attached, I can use those as the visual target to keep the look aligned with what you want. I’m also happy to clarify any details before starting so the output matches your expectations.

As an example of my work, I built a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. using Python and scikit-learn. It routed incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues through a FastAPI service, with nightly retraining handled by a Celery worker on Redis. That system reached a macro-F1 of 0.88 versus 0.62 for the old keyword rules, and reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes. That project reflects the kind of careful, reliable implementation I bring to AI work.

If you’d like, I can also help organize the deliverables so you receive the avatar clips in a clear set for each emotion and pose. Please feel free to send any extra preferences you have about expression intensity, camera framing, or how realistic you want the final look to be.
